axesFrame: Principal axes of an approximate ellipsoid. The historical 2016 spin pole is illustrative: the 2025 fit has four pole possibilities and no unique solution; absolute spin phase is not measured here.
model: Triaxial ellipsoid approximation to the 2025 conference dimensions; no resolved terrain

material.interpretation: Every source pixel is an explicit no-coverage sentinel. The existing shared coverage grid supplies the displayed material; it is not measured terrain.

referenceRadiusSource: Half the 7.0 km volume-equivalent diameter quoted by Porter et al. (2025); reference scale does not renormalize the ellipsoid.
